plugin.name: borderless-full-screen
plugin._long: X11 games get the screen they ask for: a full-screen window goes to the screen it asked for rather than the focused one, and a window without a frame that asks to cover a whole screen (a game's "borderless full screen") is made full screen there instead of being fitted between the menu bar and the dock.

option.name: enabled
option._long: Off fits such windows into the room the menu bar and dock leave.
